inputs.checklistItemText: Adjacent driveways within 300 feet not shown on plans (DRV-04)
inputs.question: Are adjacent driveways on neighboring properties shown on this sheet? Look for driveways on properties adjacent to the subject site along Collier Street, Kinney Avenue, or Nash Avenue. Adjacent driveways would appear as wide, flat-bottomed U-shapes or J-shapes opening toward the street on adjacent parcels.
inputs.regionHint: along Collier Street, Kinney Avenue, and Nash Avenue on adjacent properties

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/feature-identification question—whether adjacent driveways appear on the sheet at all—rather than measuring the 300-foot spacing between them. This is a progressive verification step (presence check before measurement); routing follows the agent question, not the overall requirement type.
